source: SEC EDGAR companyfacts, earliest `filed` per period_end
artifact_rule: lag > 180d treated as XBRL-adoption / pre-IPO artefact, not a late filing; lag < 0 treated as an EDGAR mis-tag and excluded as a look-ahead leak

proxy_90d.note: GENUINE look-ahead exposure only: periods where the fact was not public at period_end+90 and the lag is not an artefact
proxy_90d.second_note: a 90d proxy is CONSERVATIVE for the median period -- it waits longer than needed, discarding public information
